claims: The Artemis 2 Orion capsule is cone-shaped.
The Artemis 2 Orion capsule measures 16.5 feet (5 meters) in diameter.
The Artemis 2 Orion capsule is roughly 11 feet tall.
The Artemis 2 Orion capsule has 330 cubic feet (about 9.3 cubic meters) of habitable volume.
The Orion capsule has a crew capacity of 4 astronauts.
The Orion capsule offers 60% more room than Apollo command modules.
The Orion capsule is roughly 60% larger than Apollo capsules.
The Orion capsule heat shield diameter is ~16.5 ft.
The Orion capsule is for a 10-day four-person mission.
The Orion capsule includes a toilet within the cabin.
The Orion capsule includes exercise equipment within the cabin.
The Orion capsule includes a medical kit within the cabin.
